title: 1981 Black Sea exercise sighting, cameras seized and secrecy pledges signed

tellings.quote: During the exercises on the Black Sea, several dozen unidentified craft flew in directly. People even photographed them with simple cameras. This was in 1981.

plain: During military exercises on the Black Sea in 1981, several dozen unidentified craft flew straight in, and people photographed them with simple cameras. Afterward, the story goes, the cameras were seized and people signed pledges to keep quiet. A man introduced as the president of a Russian republic tells Michels he was there, and he tells it as proof that the Soviet military saw these craft up close and buried it.
